pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark patches exhibit high edge angularity with sharp pixel gradients between the dark interior and light borders. Patch area is non-uniform, with larger, more consolidated geometric forms on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways separates the darker patches. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing significantly between smaller patches on the rear quarter while maintaining continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a jagged 1D contour against the background, characterized by a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration pattern from individual hair clusters.
